product_family: Bito provides AI-powered development tools including AI Architect (system context for technical design and code review) and AI Code Review Agent. Both are available as VS Code extensions, CLI tools, and APIs. Products include code-aware code review, technical design, impact analysis, and scope breakdown.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Bito announced on December 30, 2024: 'we have achieved SOC 2 Type II compliance.' The announcement states: 'This milestone underscores our dedication to the highest standards of data security and operational excellence' and that 'Type II compliance goes a step further by assessing how these controls perform over time.' Homepage also states 'SOC 2 Type II certified.'

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Bito's own domain. Third-party security profiles (Nudge Security) claim ISO 27001 compliance, but this is not confirmed on bito.ai or in Bito's official documentation, trust center, or security pages.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Bito's privacy policy addresses GDPR: 'When our processing is subject to international laws, including but not limited to the General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR") that governs individuals located in the European Economic Area ("EEA").' It states legal bases including performance of a contract, legitimate interests, and consent, and that EEA/UK/Swiss transfers use 'Standard Contractual Clauses or obtaining your consent.' A Data Processing Addendum is available for enterprise customers. Note: GDPR is a regulation, not a formal certification; compliance is self-reported.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Bito's own domain or official documentation. Third-party security profiles claim HIPAA compliance, but this is not confirmed on bito.ai.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Bito's own domain. PCI DSS is primarily relevant for payment processors and is not mentioned in Bito's security or compliance documentation.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Bito's own domain. FedRAMP is a government-specific compliance program and is not mentioned in Bito's official security pages or documentation.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Bito's own domain. CSA STAR certification is not mentioned in Bito's official security or compliance documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Bito explicitly states in its privacy policy: 'Bito and our LLM partners do not store your code, and none of your data is used for model training.' The AI Usage Policy confirms: 'Source code and related data are processed securely and protected under our Privacy Policy. We do not use customer data to train public models without consent.' Code and AI requests are neither retained nor viewed by Bito.
privacy.data_region: United States (with flexibility for on-prem and customer-cloud deployments)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: All requests transmitted over HTTPS with full encryption in transit

security.name: Code Storage
security.value: No code is stored on Bito servers unless explicitly authorized. Code, prompts, and data are never retained by Bito or third-party LLM providers.

security.name: Deployment Options
security.value: Flexible deployment: on-premise, customer cloud, or Bito cloud. Enterprises can integrate with private LLM accounts (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Cloud, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) routed through customer VPCs.

security.name: Data Processing
security.value: Data Processing Addendum with Standard Contractual Clauses available for enterprise customers

security.name: Content Moderation
security.value: Automatic moderation of interactions to prevent toxic and brand-unsafe outputs

products.name: AI Architect
products.data_scope: Reads code, commits, docs, issues to build knowledge graph. No code storage or model training. Flexible deployment.
products.notes: Builds system context through codebase analysis. Supports on-prem and cloud deployment. Integrates with Jira, Linear, Slack.

products.name: AI Code Review Agent
products.data_scope: Analyzes pull requests and diffs. Code not stored unless authorized.
products.notes: Available as VS Code extension, CLI, and API. Claims 89% reduction in merge time and 34% reduction in regressions. Requires system context for accurate reviews.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with premium tiers; pricing not fully detailed in public docs
compare.data_residency: US default; on-prem and customer-cloud options available; flexible deployment

flags: Over-claim risk: Nudge Security's third-party profile claims ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR compliance, but none of these are confirmed on Bito's official domain or public documentation.
Trust center URL (trust.bito.ai) exists but contains no publicly accessible detailed compliance information; only redirects.
While SOC 2 Type II is well-documented, other certifications commonly expected in the AI dev-tools space (ISO 27001, HIPAA for healthcare use cases) are not publicly evidenced.
GDPR compliance is stated and DPA is available, but Bito has not pursued formal GDPR certification; compliance is self-reported.
Data residency is US-based; enterprises requiring EU data residency may face challenges despite on-prem deployment option.
